name: Pellets × 100
notes: Each load is 100 actual pellets and has the same volume as 5 large Rounds

name: Pouch, Tiny
notes: 5-cubic inches. Holds 40 large Rounds, 80 Rounds, 120 small Rounds, 300 very small Rounds

name: Pouch, Small
notes: 20-cubic inches. Holds 150 large Rounds, 300 Rounds, 600 small Rounds, 1200 very small Rounds

name: Powder Horn
notes: 5-cubic inches. Has measuring tool. Enough Blackpowder for 50-200 shots depending on Round size

name: Firearm Kit
notes: Contains flint rock, oil vial, drill ream, rag, ram rod. Each of correct length for Firearm purchased.

name: Wadding Kit
notes: A sheet of thin cloth pre-cut into 10 strips of 10 tear-away patches allowing for 100 shots.

name: Case, Tiny
notes: Holds 10 Bolts up to 6-Inches length. Case must be opened. Can jam in another 5.

name: Case, Small
notes: Holds 10 Bolts up to 20-Inches length. Case must be opened. Can jam in another 5.

name: Case
notes: Holds 10 Bolts up to 36-Inches length. If case is opened, can store and retrieve another 5.

name: Case, Large
notes: Holds 10 Bolts of any size. If case is opened, can store and retrieve another 10, or 15 loosely

name: Magazine
notes: Holds 5 Bolts for a Repeating Crossbow

name: Magazine
notes: Holds 8 Heavy Bolts for a Heavy Repeating Crossbow

name: Boltheads, Blunt × 10
notes: Bulbous and weighted front. Add Stun trait to Bolt, but reduce ORa, Dmg, and Impact by 2.

name: Crossbow Kit
notes: 2 metal bowstrings, vial of oil, screwdriver, pliers, rag

name: Quiver, Belt
notes: Holds 10 Arrows of any length. Can jam in another 5

name: Quiver, Small
notes: Holds 20 Arrows of any length. Can jam in another 10

name: Quiver, Large
notes: Holds 30 Arrows of any length. Can jam in another 15

name: Arrowheads, Blunt × 10
notes: Bulbous and weighted front. Add Stun trait to Arrow, but reduce ORa, Dmg, and Impact by 3.

name: Arrowheads, Grappling × 10
notes: 4-pronged front to catch cables, ropes, or to deliver messages. Reduce ORa, Dmg, and Impact by 3.

name: Arrowheads, Bodkin × 10
notes: Very narrow point to attack armor. Add Impale trait.

name: Bowyer’s Kit
notes: 2 Bowstrings, 10 Arrow fletches, 10 standard Arrow heads, vial of oil, glue, straps, rag

name: Pouch, Small
notes: 20-cubic inches. Holds 100 large Bullets, 300 Bullets, 500 small Bullets

name: Scroll, Encharged
notes: A scroll within three badglass quartz rings on a ribbon or string. Provides 3 charges.

name: Scroll Case, basic
notes: 10-inches long by 2-inches diameter, and a cupped removable lid on a hinge.

name: Scroll Case, batteried
notes: As the basic scroll case, but also has inlaid badglass gemstones within. +3 Charges

name: Scroll Case, triple
notes: 12-inches long by 3-inches diameter, same as basic scroll case, but can fit three scrolls.

name: Scroll Case, triple batteried
notes: As the triple scroll case, but with +10 Charges. Badglass crystals within its cap interior.

name: Battery, small × 1
notes: A 1-inch diameter, 10-inch Blackmetal cylinder with badglass crystals; treat as Manastore 20 for fast play.

name: Badglass, crystals × 1
notes: 300 badglass crystals of nearly uniform shape and size; enough raw material for roughly Manastore 20 when properly housed.

name: Riding kit
notes: Saddle, stirrups, bridle, crop, blinders, brush, 8 shoes, shoe-knife, file, nail clippers.

name: Bathing Kit
notes: Everything necessary to maintain hygiene and basic grooming. Wash rag, bathing soap, shampoo, fragrances, shaving blade, mirror, scraping knife, loofa sponge. Supports ordinary hygiene and grooming. Hygiene becomes a Social or sensory concern only when the Fiction makes it relevant.

name: Beauty Kit
notes: Everything necessary for a specific Region. Lotions, salves, mascara, lipstick, lip balms, tweezers, brush, comb, hair ties, cotton swabs, mints. Supports deliberate grooming and presentation. Use the ordinary Social presentation guidance when it matters.

name: Whetting Kit
notes: Sharpens blades, points, edges, and spikes. Creates +1 Impact and +1 Dmg on the first few dozen attacks for any Melee weapon that has Pierce, Cleave, or Impale.

name: Perfume kit
notes: Several popular fragrances specific to a Region. Contains 1-cuin atomizers × 5. Over-use can make the character odorous and easily detectable. May mask ordinary odors when the Fiction allows; strong or inappropriate fragrance can instead become conspicuous.

name: Administrator Kit
notes: Inkpot, Quill, Vellum sheets, Stamp of Office, Signet Ring or Amulet

name: Armorer’s Kit
notes: Hammer, straps, grommets, screwdriver, pliers, file, prybar

name: Dining kit
notes: Spoons × 4, forks × 4, chopsticks × 10, bowls × 4, tin cups × 4

name: Lockpick kit
notes: Tools × 10 allowing one marked failure each. DM +1 to pick mechanical locks.

name: Tattoo kit
notes: Inkpot × 10 standard colors, vial of tea oil, vial of disinfectant, cloth bandages × 10, tattoo needles × 10, blotting rag

name: Scrivener kit
notes: Pages × 100, inkpot, eraser, blotting rag, ink thinner, wax bar, 1 each signet ring and stamp for family-office-station of choice, quills × 10

name: Spelunk kit
notes: Pitons × 20, piton hammer with claw, carabiner × 20, talcum powder × 10-Days usage

name: Cooking kit
notes: 500-cuin pot, 200-cuin saucepan. Can provide for 16 persons for a small meal each.

name: Caltrops, small × 100
notes: Caltrops (100 sqft). Each 1-inch metal spiked tetrahedron. Affects SIZ 5 to 20. Dmg 1D-4.

name: Caltrops, medium × 30
notes: Caltrops (100 sqft). Each 2-inch metal spiked tetrahedron. Affects SIZ 15 to 35. Dmg 1D-2.

name: Caltrops, large × 10
notes: Caltrops (100 sqft). Each 3-inch metal spiked tetrahedron. Affects SIZ 25 to 50. Dmg 1D-2.

name: Horseshoes × 4
notes: For the standard SIZ 18 to 22 Steed.

name: Blanket, Heavy
notes: Ignore 20-Farenheit of Cold weather. Allows 2 Persons, or 1 Steed.

name: Blanket, Light
notes: Ignore 10-Farenheit of Cold weather. Allows 2 persons, or 1 Steed.

name: Lore Book
notes: Specify Lore topic. Contains illustrations, margin-notes, references. DM +1 Research.

name: Map Book
notes: Specify topic as Empire, Region, and Settlement for specific accuracy in that Week hex. DM -1D anything below Day hex accuracy outside of a known highway or road. DM -1 each Day hex away from the Settlement identified.

name: Skill Book
notes: As a Lore tome, but includes rubrics and practice exercises.

name: Library, Small
notes: Contains about 20 significant written works which can be specified when the occasion arises.

name: Library, Large
notes: Contains about 100 significant written works which can be specified when the occasion arises.

name: Library, Huge
notes: A substantial collection of about 1000 significant written works. Restricted to Cities.

name: Library, Immense
notes: A major collection of about 10K significant written works. Restricted to Metropolises and Citystates.

name: Bookshelf
notes: 36-inch wide by 18-inch deep with wall supports. Holds about 30 books or 20 scrolls

name: Bookcase, Small
notes: Holds 3 small bookshelves, with a bonus shelf atop. Holds about 100 books or 60 scrolls.

name: Boots, Fashion
notes: High, narrow, heels 2-inch thick. Creates DM +1 for any Tests involving fashion to those who might care. Penalized MOV – 1 Jog or Run, and DM -1 any Tests involving Agility.

name: Boots, Rugged
notes: Can travel about 6-Months over terrain. Has 0.5-inch thick leather soles, a heel 1-inch thick.

name: Boots, Soft
notes: Very soft leather with a think 0.1-inch sole with or without a heel.

name: Cloak Or Cape
notes: Varies in length. Boat-cloaks are thicker and longer. Riding capes are shorter and thinner.

name: Glove, Leather × 2
notes: Can be open-fingers, or even have wrist-straps.

name: Headgear, Cap or Hat
notes: Varies by region and even settlement.

name: Leggings, Elastic
notes: Can be of any design, but usually a single color. Breathes well with change of weather.

name: Leggings, Leather
notes: Can be of any color. Doesn’t breathe well during bad weather, causing annoyance DM -1.

name: Robe
notes: Many varieties; bath robe, dress robe, fashion robe, professional robes, etc.

name: Sandals
notes: Thick with straps that lead up to the knees. 0.2-inch thick leather soles.

name: Outfit, Fitted
notes: This is pants, blouses, dresses, skirts, vests, etc. An outfit for wearing about a Town or City.

name: Outfit, Full
notes: This is for wearing at events. Usually kept clean and ready. It can help where formal or event dress is relevant.

name: Outfit, Simple
notes: This is for travelling, labor, or just wearing by default. It can hinder Social interaction only where such clothing is materially inappropriate.

name: Shirt, Leather
notes: Short-sleeved. Soft leather meant for comfort and fit.

name: Tunic
notes: Tend to have great variations similar to hats (see Hat).

name: Rings
notes: Each hand can wear 3 rings, each ear-nose-bellybutton-cheek allows 1 ring piercing.

name: Bracelets & Bangles
notes: A person can wear 2 necklaces, and 1 bracelet (or anklet) per arm or foot

name: Necklaces & Amulets
notes: A person can wear a single necklace plus another simpler chain with a pendant or amulet.

name: Vials × 10
notes: Each holds 10-cuin of fluid. A “small cup”.

name: Flasks × 10
notes: Each holds 20-cuin of fluid. A “tall glass” or a “serving”.

name: Flagon × 10
notes: Each holds 100-cuin of fluid. About 0.1 cuft space required.

name: Flagon, Large × 10
notes: Each holds 250-cuin of fluid. About 0.2 cuft space required.

name: Chest, Small
notes: 0.5 cuft. Has a decorative design. Has fastener and a small padlock.

name: Chest, Large
notes: 1 cuft. Has a decorative design. Has fastener and a small padlock.

name: Trunk, Small
notes: 2 cuft. Has fastener and a small padlock.

name: Trunk, Large
notes: 3 cuft. Has fastener and a small padlock.

name: Keg, Small
notes: 0.5 cuft. Must be nailed shut, and pried open. Has an optional spigot.

name: Keg, Large
notes: 1.5 cuft. Must be nailed shut, and pried open. Has an optional spigot.

name: Barrel, Small
notes: 3 cuft. Must be nailed shut, and pried open. Has an optional spigot.

name: Barrel, Large
notes: 6 cuft. Must be nailed shut, and pried open. Has an optional spigot.

name: Backpack, Framed
notes: Holds 1-cuft. Can support up to 2-cuft if packed outside of the backpack.

name: Backpack, Frameless
notes: Holds 1-cuft. Has shoulder and waist straps, and made of boiled leather.

name: Purse
notes: Holds 10-cuin. Has a strap fastener. Has a shoulder strap of any design.

name: Purse, Large
notes: Holds 20-cuin. Has a twist-and-lock fastener. Has a shoulder strap of any design.

name: Case, map
notes: 16-inches long and 4-inches diameter. Unfurls a single map 16 × 32 dimensions. Specify the Region or Settlement to have mapped.

name: Case, scroll
notes: 8-inches long and 2-inches diameter. Has endcaps and a transparent crystal viewport.

name: Case, tome
notes: 16 × 10 × 4 inches. Reinforced leather slipcase to protect Tomes and Codices.

name: Rope
notes: 100-feet by 1-Inch diameter of twisted fiber. Can bear 5000-Pounds

name: Twine
notes: 1000-feet by 0.2-Inch diameter of twisted dense silk fiber. Can bear 500-Pounds

name: Candle × 10
notes: 1-cuin of wax and wick in a long narrow candle. Each candle burns for 12-Hours. Light OR 25-Feet.

name: Torches × 10
notes: Each torch burns for 6-Hours. Made of cloth and pitch wrapped upon sticks of wood. Light OR 50-Feet.

name: Lamp
notes: Has 1-cuin oil reservoir, empty. Un-hooded. Light OR 50-Feet.

name: Lantern
notes: Has 10-cuin oil reservoir, empty. Adjustable bullseye with a top-handle. Light OR 50-Feet.

name: Oil Flask
notes: 20-cuin oil. Made of leather with a plug-cap. Each 1-cuin burns for 1-Hour.

name: Tinderbox
notes: About 100 uses. Has flint rock, steel striking plate.

name: Lock, common
notes: DM -1D Pick-lock Tests. Increase TCA +3 per addition; Genelock, Codelock, Triggerlock

name: Lock, complex
notes: DM -2D Pick-lock Tests. Increase TCA +3 per addition; Genelock, Codelock, Triggerlock

name: Refreshment Beverage × 10
notes: Ingredients of 100-cuin for 10 1-cup servings each. Always fresh from the local market. Regional variations are different prices, flavor, quality. See Concoctions in this book .

name: Tea Beverage
notes: A brick of enough dried leaves for 100 1-cup servings each. Specify Region, Herbal or Caffeinated. Regional variations are different prices, flavor, quality. See Concoctions.

name: Alcohol Beverage
notes: Holds 100-cuin for 10 1-cup servings each. Regional variations have difference prices, flavor, quality. Specify Region and Beer, Wine, or Spirits. See Concoctions in this book .

name: Fresh foods × 10
notes: Meals × 10; Choose type. Perishes after 1D-Days stored, 1D-Hours if not stored.

name: Salted foods × 10
notes: Meals × 10; Choose type of dried foods. Perishes after 1D-Weeks stored, 1D-Days if not stored.

name: Medicine × 10
notes: Choose × 10 of; Euphorics, Stimulants, Hallucinogenics, Psychedelics, etc.

name: Herbs & Spices × 100
notes: Meals × 100. Using this reduces 1D Stress and 1 Weariness after the conclusion of a meal.

name: Betelnut × 100
notes: Yezik readings × 100-Minutes Prevents losing memory of the Blacktongue language skill. See Blacktongue in Book IV — Character Options, under “Primary Languages” .

name: Instrument, cheap
notes: Wood reed instrument or simple banjo, bongos, tambourine, or 2-string guitar.

name: Instrument, fancy
notes: Any other sort of instrument; lute, violin, brass horns, drum set, etc.

name: Blank Tome
notes: Page × 500. Vellum, which can be scraped and re-used. Not for scribing Spells.

name: Blank Codex
notes: Pages × 100. Magepage. Each Spell level takes up 1 page, +1D if a spell if written by a Cleric. Hides indirect sight lines.

name: Blank Scroll
notes: Pages × 10. Magepage. Each Spell level takes up 1 page +1D if a spell written by a Cleric. Hides indirect sight lines.

name: Idol or Figurine
notes: A basic but stylized tiny statute of some person, Deity, Denizen, or other.

name: Bed roll, Simple
notes: Canvas. 1-person 8 × 4 Feet. 0.2-inch thick with a temperature resistant bed liner.

name: Bed roll, Padded
notes: Padded mattress. 1-person. Removes an additional 1 Weariness if restfully sleep.

name: Sleeping Bag
notes: Canvas with padding and flap. 1-person. 8 × 3 Feet. 0.2-inch thick with temperature resistant liners, reducing Cold weather effectively by 20-Farenheight

name: Half-shelter
notes: 1-person. Canvas. May combine with another Half-shelter. 10 × 6 × 4-Feet tall. Has single flap, lines, and 10 stakes.

name: Tent, small
notes: 4-person. 16 × 8 × 6-Feet tall. Canvas. May combine with another small Tent. Canvas. Has double flaps, lines, 20 stakes.

name: Tent, medium
notes: 8-person. 25 × 10 × 8-Feet tall. Canvas. May combine with another medium Tent. Has double flaps, lines, 32 stakes.

name: Tent, large
notes: 20-person. 25 × 25 × 10-Feet tall. Canvas. May combine with another large Tent. Has double flaps, lines, 50 stakes.

name: Wardrobe
notes: Standard fashion for region. Non-descript and allows the wearer to blend into those crowds. Usually a robe, maybe a simple hat or cap, undergarments, a shirt, leggings.

name: Fashionware
notes: Tailored cosmopolitan fashion. Outlandish 3 , but limit utility to within Aristocratic societies.

name: Raiments
notes: Royal attire. Outlandish 2 , but limit utility to within Aristocratic societies.

name: Uniform
notes: Military, wait staff, vocational. Outlandish , but limit utility to within Aristocratic societies.

name: Starshell
notes: Battlefield illumination round. Light 16 when it opens overhead. Illuminated radius is roughly twice altitude, maximum 2,000 Feet. Reduce Light by 3 Index each 1-Minute: 16, 13, 10, 7, then it burns out.
Canonical price and weight are not listed.
